description.text: As of October 4, 2026, at least 1,455 people killed, 9,287 injured and 5,285 missing; 8,317 houses destroyed and extensive damage to bridge, road and power infrastructure in Nepal, including 109 bridges, 69 km of roads and 13 hydropower projects. At least 43 people killed and 519 missing, 27 buildings destroyed and communication, power and road access disrupted in Gyirong, China. The landslide location was obtained from satellite imagery.
